title: Prior Predictive Matching for Bayesian LoRA
abstract: arXiv:2610.35457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provide principled uncertainty estimation when fine-tuning large foundation models, but require specifying the prior over the low-rank weight updates. We address this hyperparameter selection problem by introducing a closed-form prior-predictive estimator that operates before fine-tuning.   We analyze a second-order expansion of the network and quantify how the low-rank prior drives function-space deviations from the pretrained outputs. We also show that these prior-predictive quantities depend on the prior only through the product of the adaptation rank and the fourth power of the prior scale. Because the training targets share a single draw of the latent weight update, we can leverage the covariance between example residuals to derive a moment-matching estimator. translated_title: 贝叶斯LoRA的先验预测匹配
translated_abstract: 低秩适配（LoRA）的贝叶斯变体在微调大型基础模型时能够提供有原则的不确定性估计，但需要为低秩权重更新指定先验分布。我们通过引入一种在微调之前即可运行的闭式先验预测估计器，来解决这一超参数选择问题。我们分析了网络的二阶展开，并量化了低秩先验如何驱动函数空间偏离预训练输出。我们还证明了这些先验预测量仅通过适配秩与先验尺度四次幂的乘积依赖于先验分布。由于训练目标共享同一次潜在权重更新的采样，我们可以利用样本残差之间的协方差推导出矩匹配估计器。此外，我们的理论分析表明，最优先验精度随秩 r 以 $r^{-1/2}$ 的比例缩放。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种闭式先验预测匹配估计器，可在微调之前为贝叶斯LoRA自动确定先验超参数，并从理论上证明了最优先验精度应随适配秩按 r^{-1/2} 缩放。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a closed-form prior-predictive moment-matching estimator that automatically selects prior hyperparameters for Bayesian LoRA before fine-tuning, and theoretically establishes that the optimal prior precision scales as r^{-1/2} with the adaptation rank.
